data.body: Deferral disposition (epic 2f4c close): PRE-EXISTING defect in the DC transport pagination path (transport.py _paged_search offset-stall), identified by cabc's Phase-1 sibling sweep — not introduced or touched by any epic 2f4c deliverable. The Cloud-side counterpart was fixed under ab7f (shared cursor-pagination iterator, commit 30c522cde9); this DC sibling is its own unit of work with the fix shape documented in the description (adopt the same shared iterator / stall guard). Remains open and ready for claim by the next agent.
